Context: 1-B. 'Workplace' includes:-

5. (a) The mechanism of the complaints committee, provided under Yishakha guidelines relating to sexual harassment should be strictly in accordance with the judgment, to ensure that the committee is effective and functional at all times.  
The Complaints Committee, shall at all times be in existence and any  
changes in composition of committee should be publicized.  
- GID (25-F), Rule 3-C.
